info.name: Estate Data Collection (EDC) API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman test kit for the Estate Data Collection (EDC) Azure Functions platform (Public & Admin Function Apps).

Covers:
0. Health & Version Observability (GET /api/about)
1. Admin Schema & Multi-Engine Quality Rule Verification (POST /api/schemas/verify — JSON Schema Draft-07 & 2020-12, ODCS v3.2.0 YAML, JsonLogic & CEL)
2. Admin Schema Ingestion, Scheduling & Catalogue Management (POST /api/schemas/{schemaName}/versions/{version}, PATCH /api/schemas/{schemaName}/versions/{version}/schedule, GET /api/schemas, GET /api/schemas/{schemaName}/versions/{version})
3. Public Schema Discovery & Catalogue (GET /api/schemas, GET /api/schemas/{schemaName}, GET /api/schemas/{schemaName}/versions/{version})
4. CDC Survey Submission Lifecycle (POST /api/submissions/{cdcSchemaName}, GET /api/submissions/{submissionId}, PUT /api/submissions/{submissionId}, GET /api/submissions/{submissionId}/check, POST /api/submissions/{submissionId}/finalise)
5. ODCS v3.2.0 Survey Sites Workflow (edc-survey-sites)
6. CDC Survey Two-Step Validation Pipeline (cdc_survey with 10 Quality Rules)

item.name: 1.5 Verify ODCS v3.2.0 Contract via Raw YAML (Route B)

exec: pm.test("ODCS v3.2.0 YAML contract parsed and verified", function () {

body.raw:
version: "1.0.0"
kind: DataContract
apiVersion: v3.2.0
id: edc-survey-sites
name: CCDSurveySubmission-Sites
status: draft
schema:
  - name: submission
    logicalType: object
    description: Top-level CCDSurveySubmission-Sites payload container
    properties:
      - name: survey
        logicalType: object
        required: true
        quality:
          - id: CDC-DQ1-JSONLogic
            type: custom
            engine: jsonlogic
            description: Survey updated timestamp must be greater than or equal to survey creation timestamp.
            implementation:
              ">=":
                - var: survey.updated_at
                - var: survey.created_at
        properties:
          - name: id
            logicalType: string
            required: true
            logicalTypeOptions:
              pattern: "^SURV-[A-Za-z0-9-]+$"
          - name: survey_name
            logicalType: string
            required: true
          - name: participant_id
            logicalType: string
            required: true
          - name: surveyor_email
            logicalType: string
            required: false
            logicalTypeOptions:
              format: email
          - name: is_complete
            logicalType: boolean
            required: true
          - name: created_at
            logicalType: timestamp
            required: true
          - name: updated_at
            logicalType: timestamp
            required: true
      - name: school
        logicalType: object
        required: true
        properties:
          - name: urn
            logicalType: string
            required: true
            logicalTypeOptions:
              pattern: "^[0-9]{6}$"
          - name: name
            logicalType: string
            required: true
      - name: sites
        logicalType: array
        required: true
        items:
          logicalType: object
          required: true
          properties:
            - name: name
              logicalType: string
              required: true
            - name: blocks
              logicalType: array
              required: true
              items:
                logicalType: object
                required: true
                properties:
                  - name: name
                    logicalType: string
                    required: true
                  - name: type
                    logicalType: string
                    required: true

request.description: Verifies Route B: posts a raw ODCS v3.2.0 YAML DataContract directly. OdcsContractParser compiles it to Draft-07 JSON Schema and extracts all embedded quality rules.
